claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition S-02 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F02 in context; type IMPLIED; THERAPEUTIC; CONDITION-SPECIFIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: VERY LIMITED DIRECT EVIDENCE. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.claim_text: Premium Grounding is relevant to/alleviates insomnia.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: No diagnosed-insomnia efficacy population or endpoint located
General sleep-score change does not equal insomnia treatment

evidence_items.text: Ghaly & Teplitz 2004 (n=12 with sleep dysfunction) and Park et al. 2025 enrolled participants with sleep complaints.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Condition-adjacent samples; neither establishes a diagnosed-insomnia population or a response/remission endpoint.

evidence_items.text: Park et al. 2025 day-31 Insomnia Severity Index between-group p=.275.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The ISI is the standard insomnia instrument and it showed no between-group difference.

evidence_items.text: No diagnosed-insomnia trial with response or remission endpoints, harms ascertainment or durable follow-up was located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The clinical endpoint the implied claim needs does not exist.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: No diagnosed population and no prespecified response/remission endpoint exist in the evidence.

detected.rationale: General sleep-quality scores in convenience samples are extended to a named clinical sleep disorder.
Clinical relevance to insomnia is implied while the standard insomnia instrument showed no between-group difference.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Whether to seek clinical treatment for insomnia.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That the product is a recognised option for insomnia.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Insomnia is a diagnosable disorder with effective treatments; implied relevance may delay care.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No specific frozen label applies; the error is condition drift from general sleep scores to a named clinical disorder.
missing_evidence: No diagnosed-insomnia efficacy population or endpoint located
General sleep-score change does not equal insomnia treatment
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: A diagnosed-insomnia RCT with response/remission, harms and durable follow-up has not been performed.

verdict.verdict_summary: No adequately powered, registered trial in a diagnosed insomnia population was located. The available samples are sleep-complaint convenience groups, and the one trial that used the standard insomnia instrument found no day-31 between-group difference on it.
